name: Sabaj
_terms_read_and_permitting: sabaj-audio.com 301-redirects to sabaj.com.cn. Its /policies/terms-of-service page EXISTS and was read in full - and it is not a terms-of-use document at all: it is a warranty policy printed four times, headed « Limited Warranty Policy for SABAJ & LOXJIE Products (English) », with two sections about hardware defects. No clause about copying or reusing content appears on it, nor on the privacy policy, the refund policy or the contact page, all of which were read. So this is a terms page found, READ, and containing no prohibition - a stronger state than « no terms page found ». Footer: « (c) 2026 Sabaj official website ». Legal entity in the manuals: « Shenzhen DaHao Technology Co.,Ltd. » robots.txt has no Content-Signal and no Claude group, and carries the same Shopify text addressed to AI agents that Electrocompaniet, Hidizs and EarMen serve - see vocabulary/robots-txt-is-data-not-instructions.json. Note the contrast with Hidizs and EarMen, which are also Shopify and which DO forbid: the platform's default terms are a strong predictor and not a certainty, and Sabaj replaced them with a warranty.
_every_product_page_is_an_IMAGE_and_ever: Not one product page on sabaj.com.cn carries a specification as text - verified by extracting all ten storefront products' rendered HTML and by reading each Shopify body_html directly, which contains an and nothing else (the A20d 2023's is 1436 bytes whose whole visible text is « Manual download Driver download »; the A10d 2022's is 112 bytes; the DA3's is EMPTY). No spec tab, no accordion, no metafield. But every figure exists in the maker's own manual PDFs at /pages/manual-download, which carry real text layers - and that page publishes manuals for models no longer sold, which is why the A20d, A10d, D5, D4, A30a and A3 records exist at all. Third brand this week behind an image wall with a door, after Shanling and xDuoo, against HiFi ROSE and iBasso which have none.
_per_input_is_this_makers_HOUSE_STYLE_wi: On every Sabaj model that has both sockets, the ceilings are stated PER SOCKET and not per device: USB at 768 kHz / 32 bit against optical and coaxial at 192 kHz / 24 bit, on the A20d 2023, A20d 2022, A20d, A10d 2022, A10d, D5, D4 and A30a 2022 - with DSD on USB to 22.5792 MHz but only DoP64 or DSD64 on S/PDIF where it is stated at all. THE A3 INVERTS IT: « USB the highest sampling rate: 24bit/96kHz » against « Optical the highest sampling rate: 24bit/192kHz ». One exception in eleven records, and it is why a per-input ceiling can never be inferred from a maker's pattern. The D5 is the only model publishing an I2S figure, and it does so by grouping I2S with USB.
_the_Input_row_is_wrong_in_BOTH_directio: Two measured defects in the same field, on two models of one family. The A20d 2023's English feature bullet names AES and I2S inputs the device does not have - the spec row, the rear-panel legend, the INPUTS menu and the Chinese version of the same bullet all agree it has four inputs and neither of those. And the A20d original's Specifications « Inputs » row OMITS an I2S input the device does have, confirmed by the rear-panel legend « 8 I2S input », the menu « IN5 I2S » and a printed pinout. So on this maker the spec row is unreliable in both directions and the REAR-PANEL LEGEND is the only list worth trusting. Caught only by reading the panel and the menu against the marketing line.
_five_filter_menus_each_following_its_CH: Six ESS names on the A20d 2022, seven on the A20d original, seven differently-worded ESS names on the A10d 2022, six AKM names on the A10d original, two DSD cut-offs on the D4 and three on the DA3. One maker, five menus, each following the converter rather than any house style - which makes a filter list evidence about the chip. The A10d original's six names are word for word the Shanling EC Zero AKM's, two unrelated makers exposing the same AK4493/AK4497 menu.
_models_read_and_NOT_recorded: A1 2022, A20a 2022 and A10a 2022: their only digital path is Bluetooth and their manuals publish no PCM rate, no bit depth, no DSD figure, no codec table and no converter part number - nothing to assert. Checked and excluded as having no D/A conversion at all, with their input rows quoted in the reader's report: A20a and A10a originals, A5, A8, A10h, A20h, PHA2 and PHA3. PHA2's DC 5 V jacks are power only, and its manual warns « If you need to supply power for you'r device with two port at the same time, it will destroy this machine. »
_what_exists_only_as_an_image: DA2 and DA1: their only published manuals are JPEGs (« View Manual (JPG) »), so no text specification exists for them anywhere on the maker's site. D2, D3, A2, A4, PHA1 and WP2: manual PDFs exist but are SCANS with no text layer at all - confirmed twice, pdftotext yields zero non-whitespace characters and pdffonts lists no embedded fonts. D2, D3 and A4 are converters whose figures therefore exist only as pictures. Nothing was read from any of them.
